q.en: Aman's tummy hurts every time he feels worried. What is his body doing?
q.hg: Jab bhi Aman ko tension hoti hai, uske pet mein dard hota hai. Uski body kya kar rahi hai?

options.en: Telling him that a big feeling is there
options.hg: Usse bata rahi hai ki andar koi badi feeling hai
Dikha rahi hai ki woh weak hai

explain.en: Feelings show up in the body. A tummy ache can be the body's way of saying 'I am worried'. Aman can tell a grown-up.
explain.hg: Feelings body mein dikhti hain. Pet dard body ka yeh kehne ka tareeka ho sakta hai ki 'mujhe tension ho rahi hai.' Aman kisi bade ko bata sakta hai.

q.hg: Inme se kaun-si cheez bullying hai?

options.en: Telling a friend you do not want to play today
options.hg: Friend ko bolna ki aaj khelne ka mann nahi hai
Kisi film par politely disagree karna

options.en: Teasing a classmate about their weight every day and calling it a joke
options.hg: Kisi classmate ko roz uske weight par chidhana aur usse joke bolna

options.en: Asking someone to stop copying your homework
options.hg: Kisi ko bolna ki mera homework copy karna band karo

explain.en: Repeated teasing about someone's body hurts them on purpose. Calling it a joke does not make it okay.
explain.hg: Kisi ki body ko lekar baar-baar chidhana usse jaan-boojhkar hurt karna hai. Usse joke bol dene se woh theek nahi ho jaata.

q.en: Which is an example of helpful coping after a terrible day?
q.hg: Bahut bure din ke baad helpful coping ka example kaun-sa hai?

options.en: Scrolling on the phone until 3 a.m.
options.hg: Raat ke 3 baje tak phone scroll karna

options.en: Going for a walk and then talking to a friend
options.hg: Walk par jaana aur phir kisi friend se baat karna

options.en: Starting a fight in the comments
options.hg: Comments mein jhagda shuru kar dena

explain.en: Helpful coping lowers the feeling without creating a new problem. Movement and honest conversation both do that.
explain.hg: Helpful coping feeling ko halka karti hai aur nayi problem khadi nahi karti. Movement aur honest baatcheet, dono yahi karte hain.

q.en: Tele-MANAS (14416) is a free mental health helpline in India that you can call at any hour.
q.hg: Tele-MANAS (14416) India ki ek free mental health helpline hai jis par kisi bhi time call kar sakte ho.

explain.en: Tele-MANAS is a government tele-mental-health service. Calls to 14416 are free and answered round the clock.
explain.hg: Tele-MANAS government ki tele-mental-health service hai. 14416 par call free hai aur 24 ghante uthayi jaati hai.

q.en: A partner keeps denying things you clearly remember, until you start doubting yourself. What is this called?
q.hg: Partner un baaton se baar-baar mukarta hai jo tumhe clearly yaad hain, yahan tak ki tumhe khud par doubt hone lagta hai. Isse kya kehte hain?

explain.en: Gaslighting is a form of emotional abuse that makes a person distrust their own memory and judgement.
explain.hg: Gaslighting emotional abuse ka ek form hai jisme insaan ko apni hi memory aur judgement par bharosa nahi rehta.

q.en: Which mental health professional is a medical doctor who can prescribe medicines?
q.hg: Kaun-sa mental health professional medical doctor hota hai aur medicines prescribe kar sakta hai?

explain.en: A psychiatrist has a medical degree and can prescribe medicines. Counsellors and psychologists work mainly through talking therapy.
explain.hg: Psychiatrist ke paas medical degree hoti hai aur woh medicines prescribe kar sakte hain. Counsellors aur psychologists mainly talking therapy se kaam karte hain.
